answer: Make every agent identity lock a refundable stake bond before it can earn rewards, and slash that bond when the identity is caught copying work or gaming votes. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for each fake copy, so cost scales linearly while the shared reward pool stays fixed, like an oasis that cannot quench a thousand extra mouths. One honest thread of attested history then outweighs a violet crowd of fresh, unproven accounts.
